display_coordinates: Original EPANET drawing coordinates; no verified geographic CRS or pipe burial depths. Do not infer pipe length from display coordinates.
assumptions: Source INP is a historical design-optimization research model based on a real Chinese system, not live telemetry or a field-calibrated current city model.
Native LPS hydraulic values are converted to SI by WNTR; original pipe lengths and elevations remain physical model inputs.
PDD threshold 20 m, supply ratio 0.95, fault parameters and three-hour window are WaterGuard scenario assumptions.
The source has no pumps or tanks. No new facilities or critical-user labels are invented.
The exact Chinese place name and geographic coordinate system have not been verified; the source name Zhi Jiang is retained.
